steps: Analyze student achievement data for finance edu monitoring & evaluation using NAEP and state assessment results disaggregated by subgroup
Identify highest-impact practices using Hattie visible learning effect-size database
Design improvement strategy targeting instruction, assessment, and intervention priorities
Implement with school improvement plans, coaching support, and progress monitoring
Evaluate using student growth percentiles and achievement gap closure metrics
treatments.monitoring: PHASE 1 (Weeks 1-4): Baseline — student proficiency rate using standardized assessment system. Deliverable: baseline report. PHASE 2 (Months 2-3): Early tracking — student proficiency rate measured quarterly. Target: 70% proficiency in core subjects. PHASE 3 (Months 4-6): Midpoint review — compare against NAEP achievement level benchmarks. Target: 50% of goal. PHASE 4 (Months 7-12): Maturation — student proficiency rate trending toward 80% proficiency. Escalate if <60% proficiency floor. ANNUAL REVIEW: Comprehensive audit using NAEP Assessment Framework. Report to Minister of Education.
treatments.escalation: If target outcome shows no measurable improvement after 90 days, or if implementation barriers prevent protocol adherence for >14 consecutive days, escalate to a higher education accreditation specialist for root cause analysis and intervention redesign. If the intervention produces adverse unintended effects at any point, pause implementation and request specialist review within 14 days.

treatments.escalation: If target outcome shows no measurable improvement after 90 days, or if implementation barriers prevent protocol adherence for >14 consecutive days, escalate to a higher education accreditation specialist for root cause analysis and intervention redesign. steps: Assess facility conditions for finance edu monitoring & evaluation using NCES Condition of Education survey

treatments.monitoring: PHASE 1 (Weeks 1-4): Baseline — school facility condition index using facilities condition assessment. Deliverable: baseline report. PHASE 2 (Months 2-3): Early tracking — school facility condition index measured biannually. Target: FCI above 0.75. PHASE 3 (Months 4-6): Midpoint review — compare against NCES school facilities standards. Target: 50% of goal.
